    // @effect-v4
    // @effect-diagnostics *:off
    // @effect-diagnostics promiseAllInEffect:warning
    import { Effect } from "effect"
    
    declare const ids: ReadonlyArray<string>
    declare const fetchUser: (id: string) => Promise<{ readonly name: string }>

!!! warning TS377198: `Promise.all` starts every promise at once with no concurrency bound, and they keep running when the fiber is interrupted. Use `Effect.forEach` with a concurrency option instead. effect(promiseAllInEffect)
